parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM risk_articles WHERE NOT needs_review)                          AS articles_scored,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM risk_articles WHERE NOT needs_review AND risk_level = 'HIGH')   AS high_risk,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM risk_articles WHERE NOT needs_review AND risk_level = 'MEDIUM') AS medium_risk,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM risk_articles WHERE NOT needs_review AND risk_level = 'LOW')    AS low_risk,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM risk_articles WHERE needs_review)                               AS needs_review,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM risk_articles WHERE alert_sent)                                 AS alerts_sent,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM v_kpi_by_item t)      AS by_item,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM v_kpi_by_region t)    AS by_region,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM v_kpi_by_category t)  AS by_category,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM v_kpi_weekly_trend t) AS weekly_trend,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM (
       SELECT watch_item, risk_score, risk_level, title, url
       FROM risk_articles WHERE NOT needs_review
       ORDER BY risk_score DESC, published_at DESC LIMIT 3) t)  AS top_articles;

parameters.text:
You are writing the weekly supply-chain risk summary for the procurement manager of an Indian online electronics retailer.

   Use ONLY the facts and numbers in the KPI DATA below. Do NOT calculate anything new: no percentages, totals, averages or differences that are not already written there. Write any other quantity in words, not digits.   Overall risk level rule: if HIGH is 0 and MEDIUM is 0, the overall risk is LOW. If HIGH is 0 and MEDIUM is above 0, it is MEDIUM. If HIGH is above 0, it is HIGH.
   Use watch item names and region names EXACTLY as written in the KPI DATA. Never group them into new labels (such as APAC or Asia).
If every watch item has zero HIGH and zero MEDIUM articles, say no item needs urgent attention and suggest continuing routine monitoring.

   Write 3 to 4 short sentences:
   1) overall risk level this week (say clearly if there are no HIGH-risk articles),
   2) which watch items or regions need the most attention,
   3) one practical next step for procurement.
   No headings, no bullet points, max 100 words.

   KPI DATA:
   {{ $json.kpi_text }}
